Heavy-Duty Utility Powerhouse with Operator Comfort

Built to Work. Engineered for Productivity.

The RX6640P combines strong diesel torque, high hydraulic output, and a rugged chassis design to handle demanding loader work, field tasks, and heavy implements. With a power shuttle transmission and responsive hydraulics, it is designed to increase efficiency while reducing operator fatigue during long workdays.

Features May Include:

Turbocharged Diesel Engine
Reliable 4-cylinder diesel engine delivering strong torque for heavy pulling, lifting, and PTO-driven implements.

Power Shuttle Transmission
Forward and reverse shifting without clutching for smoother loader work and faster cycle times.

4WD Capability
Standard four-wheel drive provides traction and stability in mud, gravel, slopes, and rough terrain.

High Hydraulic Output
Strong hydraulic system designed for loader responsiveness and multiple attachment compatibility.

Loader-Ready Design
Engineered for front-end loader use with strong frame support and quick-attach implement capability.

Comfortable Operator Station
Suspension seat, ergonomic controls, and open visibility for long hours of operation.

Heavy-Duty 3-Point Hitch
Category I/II compatible hitch system designed for a wide range of implements and attachments.

Service-Friendly Layout
Ground-level access points and simple maintenance design for daily upkeep and long-term reliability.
